# Primordia

> A GPU artificial-life laboratory in Rust and wgpu. One binary, `primordia`, runs five real-time simulations on compute shaders (Physarum slime mould, Particle Life, Lenia, Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion and Symbiosis, which couples agents with chemistry) with 42 presets, live GPU measurements, a novelty search over parameter mutations, and headless rendering of stills, videos and galleries. MIT licensed.

Without a command, `primordia` opens an interactive window. The commands `list` (no GPU needed), `render`, `gallery`, `recipe`, `explore` and `selftest` run headless and exit, print one JSON object with `--json`, and exit with 2 for invalid input, 3 for GPU failures and 4 for ffmpeg failures. Every PNG it writes carries the recipe that reproduces it. It needs a GPU with Vulkan, DirectX 12 or Metal.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/README.md): the worlds, features, quick start, controls, headless rendering, explore, scripting and troubleshooting
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/.claude/skills/primordia/SKILL.md): how to drive the command line, with ground rules, recipes, measurements and a cookbook
- [Command-line reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/docs/CLI.md): every command and option, generated from `--help`
- [Measurements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/.claude/skills/primordia/references/measurements.md): every world's measurements with units, meanings and which ones are vital

## Worlds

- [Physarum](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/docs/worlds/physarum.md): millions of slime-mould agents that build transport networks
- [Particle Life](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/docs/worlds/particle-life.md): particle species with asymmetric attractions that self-assemble
- [Lenia](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/docs/worlds/lenia.md): a continuous cellular automaton with Orbium gliders
- [Reaction-Diffusion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/docs/worlds/reaction-diffusion.md): Gray-Scott chemistry, from coral to spiral waves
- [Symbiosis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/primordia/main/docs/worlds/symbiosis.md): agents and chemistry coupled through three relationships
